A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a general framework for the capacity-achievability problem for conditionally Gaussian channel with bounded inputs.
we show how the capacity of a class of conditionally Gaussian channels is achieved, and we characterize the capacity-achiever for the class of conditionally-Gaussian channels with bounded inputs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
for conditionally Gaussian channel with bounded inputs, the capacity-achieveing measure is discrete.
